verdict.rationale: cubic is a code-review SaaS, not itself a coding agent, so publishing an MCP server is a fair axis. It documents an official MCP server on a dedicated page that lets coding agents read review findings, look up codebase docs, request PR reviews, and triage PR and codebase-scan issues. Setup is documented for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI, and the changelog adds subscription and seat-management tools exposed through the MCP client. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
